integrity: All-order results follow from written structural and transfer proofs; exhaustive finite verifications are supporting checks, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only standard gear graphs formed from one wheel by subdividing all rim edges exactly once; rim length at least three.
The even multiple-of-four named optimum-count expression uses an exact 12-state parity-transfer trace, not an expanded scalar recurrence.
No automorphism-orbit classification, nonminimum-palette counting, or generalized Jahangir family theorem is claimed.
Residual priority risk from unindexed studies of strong odd coloring on gear or subdivided wheel graphs.
title: Parity transitions and an optimal strong odd-coloring census of gear graphs
